Find MCP Servers

Discover MCP servers for databases, APIs, cloud services, and more.

Quick Search​

Ask your AI:

"Find me an MCP server for PostgreSQL"

Server discovery
→ AI calls discover-servers
   query: "postgresql"

Found 1 server:

postgres
PostgreSQL database access via MCP

Category: database
Capabilities: tools, resources
Official: ✓ Yes (modelcontextprotocol)

Get Installation Config​

After finding a server:

"Give me the config to install the postgres MCP server"

Installation config
→ AI calls get-server-config
   serverId: "postgres"
   format: "claude-desktop"

Add this to your claude_desktop_config.json:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "postgres": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres"],
      "env": {
        "DATABASE_URL": "postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/db"
      }
    }
  }
}

CLI Commands​

Server discovery via CLI
nexus servers search postgres

Found 1 server: postgres

nexus servers info postgres

postgres
PostgreSQL database access

Category: database
Official: Yes
Capabilities: tools, resources

Tools:
  - query: Execute SQL queries
  - list-tables: List database tables
  - describe: Describe table schema

nexus servers config postgres --format cursor

Add to .cursor/mcp.json:

Configuration Formats​

Get config for different clients:

FormatClient
claude-desktopClaude Desktop app
cursorCursor editor
vscodeVS Code with MCP extension
genericGeneric JSON format
Different formats
nexus servers config postgres --format claude-desktop
nexus servers config postgres --format cursor
nexus servers config postgres --format vscode

Adding Environment Variables​

Most database servers need connection strings:

With environment variables
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "postgres": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres"],
      "env": {
        "DATABASE_URL": "postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/mydb"
      }
    }
  }
}
Keep secrets safe

Don't commit connection strings to git. Use environment variables or a secrets manager.
